intent.zh: 扩展刚体质心辅助探针。保留完整等价入口计划。
intent.en: Extend the existing bounded rigid kinematics probe with GPU subtree mass/COM, packed inertia and motion DOFs, using static independent native references and explicit frozen-Warp zero-mass semantics. Do not claim complete G01/U057 equivalence.

acceptance: GPU computes subtree_mass, subtree_com, cinert and cdof without CPU physics fallback; existing FK output stays on-device for the second stage.
Static independent reference fixtures cover all four joint types, static ancestors and batched worlds with predeclared 2e-5 absolute/relative tolerances.
Explicitly test frozen-Warp zero-mass COM semantics and document the native CPU reference discrepancy.
Host invalid-input/layout tests, Windows GPU debug/release tests and fmt/clippy checks pass; update real evidence and auto-commit only scoped changes.
Normify preserves existing contracts, actual fingerprints and planned product modules; closure has zero architecture errors.
note: 已提交b1229f2。GPU计算四项质心字段。复用设备运动学缓冲。五组静态原生参考保持独立。零质量与微小质量另用解析证据。默认130、原生136、CUDA145、全feature155项宿主通过。各配置另有6项文档通过。全feature调试与发行各60项显式回归通过。质心CUDA两轮各5项；全feature两轮各6项。最大绝对误差4.158170539447781e-6。容限未放宽。四配置Clippy、fmt、rustdoc通过。C++参考/W4 /WX与重复哈希通过。保留187项旧契约与12项规则。不激活产品模块。不关闭旧字段变更。Linux与完整G01仍待验收。
